# Reference card

Every command is a single letter. Most then ask a follow-up at the bottom of the game screen: a direction (D-pad), a character's number (1-4) or a choice. Commands that need something special, such as a ship, a key, a gem or a ladder, simply fail if it isn't there.

## A - Attack
Attack in a direction. In combat, a character can attack straight up, down, left or right, but not diagonally.

## B - Board
Board a ship or mount a horse you're standing on.

## C - Cast
Cast a spell. Pick the character, choose W or C if that character knows both kinds of magic, then pick the spell's letter. See the Spell list.

## D - Descend
Climb down a ladder in a dungeon.

## E - Enter
Enter the town, castle, dungeon or shrine you're standing on.

## F - Fire
Fire a ship's cannons. They reach three squares. A foe sunk by cannon fire leaves no treasure, and pirate ships fire back.

## G - Get chest
Open a chest. Many are trapped. A thief, or the cleric spell Appar Unem, can disarm them first.

## H - Hand
Hand food, gold or equipment from one character to another.

## I - Ignite
Light a torch. Needed in dungeons.

## J - Join gold
Pool all the party's gold with one character, for buying expensive things.

## K - Klimb
Climb up a ladder in a dungeon.

## L - Look
Name what's in a square. Useful before stepping onto unfamiliar terrain.

## M - Modify order
Swap the positions of two characters in the party.

## N - Negate time
Stop time around the party. Needs a special item.

## O - Other
Type a verb for special situations, such as a word to say or something to do. See the typing helper in the guide.

## P - Peer
Look into a gem for an overview of where you are. On the surface it shows the whole world, in a town or castle all of the inside, and in a dungeon the whole level, ladders, doors and special objects included.

## Q - Quit
Save the game. Do this outdoors before you stop playing.

## R - Ready
Ready a weapon.

## S - Steal
Try to steal from a shop counter. Thieves are best at it. Get caught and the guards attack.

## T - Transact
Talk or trade with someone next to you. Give the direction they're in.

## U - Unlock
Unlock a door. Needs a key.

## V - Volume
Turn the sound on or off.

## W - Wear
Put on armour.

## X - X-it
Get off a ship or horse.

## Y - Yell
Shout a word that carries some distance.

## Z - Ztats
Show a character's status, inventory and equipment.

## Space - Pass
Let a turn pass without doing anything.

# On the 3DS

- Every command is on the Commands tab. Tap it, then answer the question with the D-pad, the number buttons or the keyboard.
- A is Enter, B is Esc, X is Space (Pass), ZL is Ztats.
- O and Y open the keyboard for you.

The original reference card isn't in the GOG release. If you have a scan, put its pages (JPG) in /3ds/u3-3ds/books/refcard and they'll show up next to this list.
